motion.name: state-change

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #F59E0B; color: #0F172A; padding: 9px 16px; font: 700 14px Ubuntu, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #EA580C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D9488; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-metric { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr; gap: 11px; min-width: 240px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: #0F172A; font-family: Ubuntu, sans-serif; } .ds-metric-icon { display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:#E6FFFB;color:#0D9488; } .ds-metric-icon svg { width:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2; } .ds-metric small,.ds-metric p { display:block;margin:0;color:#64748B;font-size:11px; } .ds-metric strong { display:block;font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Outlined Field
components.description: Comfortable form field used throughout administration flows.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid;gap:6px;color:#334155;font:600 12px Ubuntu,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height:48px;border:2px solid #CBD5E1;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;padding:0 12px;color:#0F172A;font:400 14px Ubuntu,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:0;border-color:#0D9488; } .ds-field input:disabled { background:#F1F5F9;color:#94A3B8; }

components.css: .ds-rank { display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;color:#334155;font-family:Ubuntu,sans-serif; } .ds-rank>b { color:#94A3B8;font-size:10px; } .ds-rank span { display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px; } .ds-rank strong { color:#0F172A;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-rank i { display:block;height:6px;margin:6px 0 5px;border-radius:4px;background:#E8EEF2;overflow:hidden; } .ds-rank em { display:block;height:100%;min-width:2px;border-radius:inherit;background:#0D9488; } .ds-rank small { color:#64748B;font-size:10px; }

narrative.overview: A restrained, information-dense operations interface that makes scope, amounts, status, and next actions immediately legible.

rules.name: Orange Means Action
rules.body: Orange belongs to actions and attention states, not general decoration.

rules.name: Data Stays Still
rules.body: Amounts, counts, dates, and ranking indices use tabular numerals.

rules.name: One Boundary
rules.body: A container uses either its established border or elevation, never both.

dos: Show only role-accessible data and actions.
donts: Do not let one chart dominate an operational page.
Do not repeat a dataset without a distinct task reason.
Do not combine bordered cards with directional shadows.
